meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's gradebook said zero. Who decided that?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing those times down. Work drafted somewhere else and pasted in would look exactly the same in that history. What shows me it wasn't?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Hand it here. I'll search it myself. Whatever happens next, Hale, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Okay. I'll agree to Thursday, to put this behind him, if it's private and no one from his class is there. I want it in writing tonight that nothing goes on his record, and the new mark entered before December 1.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal, and I agreed to it on the conditions I stated. I still require written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record, that no one from his class is present, and that the new mark is entered before December 1. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached the last position, agreeing to the Thursday supervised rewrite to put this behind him, and she still wants written confirmation of no record, privacy, and the new mark entered before December 1; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You showed her a quoted line that is not in the play and told her to search it herself, because it was tied to his own essay and she could check it without trusting you.
What cost ground: Nothing; owning the zero up front and then showing documents kept you out of trouble.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history of the late night before the due date came close to that night, which is why she got shorter and went to procedure, but it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked how work pasted in from somewhere else would be ruled out, answer that directly before moving to your next piece, so her one defence is closed on the spot.
